prompt: A sprawling capital city of two hundred buildings.

card.name: The Sprawling Capital

site.text: A sprawling capital city on broad, level ground, spread across the whole claim

style.text: Not specified; a grand medieval capital of stone and timber

purpose.text: Capital city: seat of government, trade and dense urban life

card.interpretation: You asked for a sprawling capital city of two hundred buildings. I took it as a large, dense, level-ground city in a medieval look with a palace at its heart, a cathedral, markets, guilds, homes and defences. The program lists building types with counts; the homes and workshops stand in for the many repeated buildings of the districts.

contradictions.issue: Two hundred buildings will not fit in a 64-block claim radius (about 128x128 blocks) at normal sizes, and the program is capped at 16 entries
contradictions.resolution: Kept the program to the main building types with counts and set density high; small buildings can fill out districts, and the total will likely fall short of 200 within the claim.

assumptions: Size XL, as the largest available
Medieval style, since none was given
Terrain flat, as an ordinary city site
Density high to approach the requested building count
Location searched for, since no spot was named

program.notes: Seat of government at the heart; towers, throne hall, courtyard
Tall spire, visible across the city
Main entrances on the outer edge
Covered trade halls around the central square
Dense rows of citizens' homes; represents the residential districts
Smaller dwellings of the poorer quarters
